name: Koda's World
description: Koda's World, sometimes referred to as Krin Koda after the scout of the same name, was a planet located in the Unknown Regions, in the Tarin system. It is devoid of any advanced installations, as it is home to the primitive Tempestro. This temperate planet had warm, moist, breathable air.
